cards.card_text: True or false: He also names the idols with their wicked worshipers.
cards.verse_text: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers.
cards.snippet: …and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers.

cards.card_text: The LORD says His worshipers, His scattered people, will bring Him an offering from beyond the rivers of Cush, a land south of Egypt.
cards.verse_text: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
cards.snippet: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.

cards.card_text: If worship isn't about the mountain or Jerusalem, how does Jesus say the true worshipers will worship the Father?
cards.verse_text: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
cards.snippet: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father…

cards.card_text: Jesus says the Father is seeking true worshipers like these to worship Him.
cards.verse_text: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
cards.snippet: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father…

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says, "God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth." She asked WHERE, friend, and He answered HOW.
cards.verse_text: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
cards.snippet: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”

cards.card_text: One of the women listening is Lydia from Thyatira, a dealer in purple cloth and a worshiper of God.
cards.verse_text: Among those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God.
cards.snippet: …dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God.

cards.card_text: Titus Justus, a worshiper of God, lives NEXT DOOR to the synagogue.
cards.verse_text: So Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.
cards.snippet: …synagogue and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.

cards.card_text: What couldn't they do for the worshiper?
cards.verse_text: It is an illustration for the present time, because the gifts and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse the conscience of the worshiper.
cards.snippet: …and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse the conscience of the worshiper.

cards.card_text: If those sacrifices could make worshipers perfect, what does the writer say would have happened to the offerings?
cards.verse_text: For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
